title: Coordinate dependence of a decoded monomial
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$. The sign-valued function on $\{\pm1\}^n$ obtained by decoding the $\mathbb{F}_2$ monomial $\prod_{i\in S}z_i$ depends only on the coordinates in $S$: whenever two sign vectors agree on every coordinate in $S$, the function has the same value on both.
hypotheses_covered: A subset S of the n coordinates
